## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to Lunara.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What pain point does it address?

## 💭 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see in detail. How should it work?

## 🎨 User Interface
If this feature involves UI changes, please describe:
- Where should it appear in the interface?
- What controls or options should be available?
- Any specific design requirements

## 📱 Use Cases
Describe who would use this feature and in what situations:

**Use Case 1:**
- User type: [e.g., Content creator, educator, podcaster]
- Scenario: [Describe the situation]
- Benefit: [What value does this provide]

**Use Case 2:**
- User type: [e.g., Video editor, social media manager]
- Scenario: [Describe the situation]
- Benefit: [What value does this provide]

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
If you have technical knowledge about this feature:

**Backend Changes:**
- [ ] New API endpoints needed
- [ ] Database schema changes
- [ ] File processing logic
- [ ] External dependencies

**Frontend Changes:**
- [ ] New components needed
- [ ] State management changes
- [ ] Routing updates
- [ ] UI/UX design

## 📸 Mockups or Screenshots
If you have mockups, wireframes, or screenshots showing how this should look, please attach them here.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you've thought about. Why is your proposed solution better?

## 📊 Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - I can't use Lunara without this
- [ ] High - This would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have, would be useful
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement, not essential

## 🤝 Willing to Contribute
Are you willing to help implement this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I can write the code
- [ ] Yes, I can help with testing
- [ ] Yes, I can help with documentation
- [ ] No, I don't have the technical skills

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and feature requests
- [ ] I have checked that this feature doesn't already exist
- [ ] I have provided enough detail to understand the request
- [ ] I have considered the technical feasibility

## 📝 Additional Notes
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
